videos.headline: McNichols makes it four TDs with 31-yard score
videos.description: Jeremy McNichols makes his fourth trip to the end zone of the game, this time cutting through the UNLV defense from 31 yards out to make it 42-17 for Boise State.

videos.headline: Rypien's plunge finishes 19-play drive with a TD
videos.description: Boise State goes 74 yards over 19 plays that's capped off by Brett Rypien's drive into the end zone from a yard out to give the Broncos a 7-3 lead.

videos.headline: McNichols cashes in for Boise State on 6-yard TD
videos.description: After Cedrick Wilson put Boise State in business with a long punt return, Jeremy McNichols needs just one play to go outside and score to increase the Broncos' lead at 14-3.

videos.headline: McNichols busts game open with third TD of the night
